commit.message:
fix(telemetry): redact the desktop checkout account fingerprint (#10342) (#10357)

* fix(telemetry): redact the desktop checkout account fingerprint (#10342)

#10351 leaves wm_checkout_account on the live /pro URL so later plan
clicks still check the account. The digest is a stable pseudonymous
account id, and SENSITIVE_URL_PARAM_RE did not list it, so Umami,
Vercel Analytics and Sentry received it. Add it to the list. DebugBear
RUM now waits on desktop-handoff /pro views, as it does for referral
codes.

Salvaged from the superseded #10352.

* chore(docs): regenerate source attribution
